name: zilliqa-brand-identity
description: Zilliqa brand identity and application UI system. Two auto-activating skills: zilliqa-brand (official colors, Montserrat type system, gradients, logo and icon assets from the 'Zilliqa - Brand Assets - Latest' Figma file, plus a UI layer extracted from live zilliqa.com) and zilliqa-app-ui (app shells, dashboards, data tables, forms, sticky/scroll behaviour and responsive rules). Ships SVG logos, an icon set, color/gradient swatches, design tokens (JSON / CSS / Tailwind) and three verified reference builds.
